item.tib: zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus thos chog rang grol chen mo'i rgyud las, zas gtad snang ba kun 'phel
item.coloph: de ltar zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus las / zas gtad snang kun 'phel zhes bya ba / dmu gshen lhun grub rgyal po'i [~pos] bskur [~bskul] ba'i ngor / thos chung smon rgyal mu la bdag gis sbyar / dge bas 'gro rnams sangs rgyas thob par shog / lcags phag zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes la gdan sa dpal gyi steng chen du brtsams pa dge'o…
item.note: smon-rgyal mu-la seems to be equivalent to smon-rgyal nam-mkha' ye-shes (mu la is a zhang-zhung equivalent for tibetan nam mkha'), which is a name for kun-grol grags-pa. (see dpal-tshul, history [beijing edition], vol. 2, p. 461, line 1). if this is correct, then the date of this work ought to be near the end of the year 1731 or the beginning of 1732. composed at steng-chen monastery. compare the colophon to our text no. 71.6, composed in the same year and same place by kun-grol grags-pa.
